name: Inequality Misdirection
description: Rephrases the undirected inequality t_u != t_v as "one account receives a tier that is strictly greater than the other's tier". Models relying on keyword matching will associate "strictly greater" with DAGs, topological sorting, or directed difference constraints, rather than undirected bipartite coloring, while genuine reasoners will easily deduce that for values restricted to {1, 2}, this simply means they must be different.
